description: This Java source file defines the NotificationEntity class, which maps to a database table for storing notification data within the Thingsboard platform. It includes fields for request ID, recipient ID, notification type, delivery method, subject, text, additional configuration, info, and status, along with methods for converting between database entity and data object.

classes.name: NotificationEntity
classes.description: Entity class representing notification data stored in the database, with fields for request ID, recipient ID, type, delivery method, subject, text, additional config, info, and status, and methods for converting to and from Notification data objects.

methods.name: NotificationEntity
methods.description: Constructor that initializes NotificationEntity from a Notification object.

methods.name: toData
methods.description: Converts the NotificationEntity instance back to a Notification data object.
